name: AMS1117-3.3 regulator module
description: Small linear regulator board that makes 3.3 V from 5 V, for 3.3 V sensors and modules.
notes: AMS1117: 1 A max, dropout about 1.1 V (1.3 V max), input absolute max 15 V. A linear regulator burns (Vin - 3.3 V) x I as heat: from 5 V at 0.5 A that is 0.85 W, already warm on a small board.
Several board styles exist: 3-pin VIN/GND/VOUT, and 4-pin boards with a 5 V pass-through. Pin order varies: read the silkscreen.

pins.name: VIN
pins.label: VIN
pins.note: 4.5-12 V (absolute max 15 V). At least about 1.2 V above 3.3 V.

pins.name: 3V3
pins.label: 3.3V
pins.note: Up to 0.8 A from 5 V in if the board can shed the heat (about 1.4 W); less from higher input voltages.
